name: Rocket Chain Reaction
description: A helper box that destroys ANY box on the maze from a distance.
howToPlay: Rockets don't open when tapped. Tap a regular box next to a rocket and it ignites, then flies to a random box anywhere on the grid, destroying it instantly and sending its marbles straight into the sort columns — magnet style.
author: prototype/rocket-chain-reaction

showcaseLevel.name: Rocket Test Lab
showcaseLevel.desc: Tap a box next to the rocket to light it
